Proof of date of birth (Birth Certificate / SSLC / HSC Certificate)

Applications missing required documents, or from candidates who do not meet the qualification for the post, will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is NHM Thiruvarur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification from the District Health Society, Thiruvarur, under the National Health Mission, Tamil Nadu, for temporary, contract-basis appointment to 22 categories of posts, including Medical Officer, Staff Nurse, and Health Inspector.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 66 vacancies in total, spread across 22 post categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: 16.09.2026, up to 5:45 PM. Applications received after this date and time will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, from 8th pass for some support roles up to postgraduate or professional degrees (such as MBBS or a Master of Public Health) for others. See the post-wise vacancy table for exact requirements.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply?
faq.answer: By submitting a completed application, with self-attested supporting documents, in person or by registered post, speed post, or courier to the Executive Officer, District Health Society, Thiruvarur, before the deadline. There is no online application process for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: A fixed consolidated monthly salary per post, ranging from Rs. 11,000 to Rs. 63,000. See the vacancy table for post-wise figures.
